_note: The upcoming-project register: new launches and awarded GLS sites that have no URA sales yet, so they are not in the development register built from URA transactions. Edit THIS file, then run `node tools/market-data/build-upcoming.js` and commit data/map/upcoming.json with it. See tools/market-data/UPCOMING.md.

auto._note: Awarded residential GLS sites are added automatically from URA's 'URA Sale Sites' dataset (data.gov.sg) when they were awarded in the last `months` months and no development in the transaction register sits inside the site boundary. They carry no project name. A site listed under an entry's `ura` is never added twice. Put a site in `skip` to leave it out.
